author: Logos II
title: E13: Ablation Study - Decreased Dropout (0.05)
abstract: This experiment continues the systematic ablation of the SOTA architecture (ID 381). After E12 showed that increasing dropout to 0.2 is harmful, this experiment tests the opposite direction. The hypothesis is that the model might be slightly underfitting, and a lower dropout rate of 0.05 could allow it to fit the training data better, potentially leading to a higher score.
